description: A token over a verbatim token keeps the verbatim token's periods: runs of pauses are made one by token, not by character, and a pause token at either end is left out (engine §5).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [part] ...
%rule part v | pause | y
%rule v "a" "." "." "b"
%emits $ <"V">
%verbatim
%rule pause "-"
%emits $ <"P" ∪ /./>
%rule y "y"
%emits $ <"Y" ∪ /y/>
```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text all
%emits $ <"Z">
%rule all [any] ...
%rule any V | P | Y
```
